data.title: 初雪 · 山路面包店
data.description: 她隔着玻璃指向一块刚出炉的面包，又认真问店主能否把另一块也包上，留给稍后见面的人。
data.action: 在柜台前挑选刚出炉的面包
data.camera: 中景，面包柜与人物同框
data.promptProse: Inside a rustic alpine bakery filled with the mouthwatering aroma of toasted caraway and yeast, Pramanix stands before a warm wooden glass display counter, pointing with a gloved finger at a crusty round loaf of mountain sourdough. Morning sunbeams illuminate floating flour dust, hanging herb bundles, and snowy mountain slopes visible through the front door.
